serialization: UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=true, no floating point values
locusSemantics: opaque commitments; no inherited botanical or performance interpretation

translation.classification: source annotation only; never indica/sativa allele fractions
translation.flavors: source annotation only; no locus decoding claim
translation.terpenes: source annotation only; no fixed chemotype or medical effect
translation.morphology: source annotation only, including explicit nulls
translation.ancestry: retain all attributed candidates and uncertainty; not a fabricated breeding event
translation.readerEffects: research only; excluded from reference trait annotations
translation.performance: no research-derived yield, flowering, resistance, climate, potency or rarity advantage
translation.loci: Keccak of canonical JSON [locus domain, cultivar ID, reference version, zero-based locus index, research-entry Keccak]; exactly 28
translation.metadata: Keccak of canonical JSON metadata object including source evidence, descriptive annotations and translation policy commitment
translation.genomeId: Keccak of canonical JSON [genome domain, cultivar ID, reference version, line ID, metadata hash, all 28 loci]
translation.lineId: Keccak of canonical JSON [line domain, cultivar ID]; stable across reference versions

registration.executionStage: HC-SEED-04; no live registration performed by generation

existingEngine.GenomeRegistry: immutable 28-byte32-locus records and post-Genesis capability gate
existingEngine.BreedingEngine: per-locus parent selection from fulfilled entropy, with existing bounded hash mutation; no botanical decoder
existingEngine.CultivationEngine: environment-derived stress/quality; seals genome identity without decoding loci
existingEngine.HarvestScoring: genome-ID-derived modifier of 9000 + uint256(genomeId) % 2001; unchanged; never search IDs for desired modifiers

mutationPolicy: A bred or mutated genome remains a new genome. Reference annotations apply only to an exact reference record; no inferred traits from partial loci or ancestry.
versionPolicy: Never edit a published reference version in place. Metadata or input changes require a new reference version. Line ID remains stable; genome ID and metadata commitment change.
